authored_scope: A03: 40 additional source-scripted locations LV_121-LV_160; cumulative 160/200

entries.title: Island grid drainage dependency
entries.stakes: A stranded ferry has cut deliveries to the Island Grid Room while rainwater climbs the converter floor. Prove the drainage route before releasing essential island feeders.

entries.source_title: Hollow Bay Ferry Dock: Reversible reset
entries.title: Hollow Bay ferry reset
entries.stakes: The ferry dock protection latch must be reset with its shore link isolated or a returning ferry pulse will re-trip the jetty and strand passengers.

entries.title: Harbour nurse competing feeds
entries.stakes: A nurse station receives contradictory shore and generator sources during the ferry outage. Keep emergency treatment lights stable while separating the feeds.

entries.title: Saltbread depot bus restart
entries.stakes: The island trading shed cannot restart its old substation while cold storage and emergency radio both draw current from the same ferry-fed trunk.

entries.source_title: Tidal Cistern Pumps: Network loop hunt
entries.title: Tidal cistern circulating fault
entries.stakes: Tidal Cistern Pumps are feeding their own low-water signal through a stranded ferry supply. Break the feedback before restoring drinking-water pressure.

entries.source_title: Northwind Radio Needle: Brief service window
entries.title: Northwind antenna service slot
entries.stakes: With ferries absent, the radio needle has only a brief battery-backed service slot. Align the antenna and complete its pulse before the isolated tower reserve expires.

entries.title: Island school freezer rescue
entries.stakes: A one-room island school uses a failing ferry-charged battery for classroom refrigeration. Protect food and medicine before restoring nonessential teaching outlets.

entries.title: Customs refuge isolated branch
entries.stakes: Old Customs Refuge must keep its fire exit lit while the intermittent ferry feed is disconnected. Build a one-way bypass with no return path into shore cables.

entries.title: Hothouse lock condensation
entries.stakes: Condensation shorts the Hothouse Main Board access switch whenever irrigation mist rises. Verify dry isolation before granting workers cabinet access.

entries.title: Seed shuttle overheated breaker
entries.stakes: The seed shuttle platform breaker keeps tripping as water beads inside its housing. Hold seed transport stationary until the thermal element is genuinely dry.

entries.title: Botany post crossfeed lock
entries.stakes: Wet greenhouse irrigation wiring has linked the Botany Health Post emergency source to the growing lamps. Separate both branches before authorizing patient refrigeration.

entries.title: Flower auction false feeder tag
entries.stakes: A mislabeled flower auction rail is powered through a condensation-coated grow-house line. Identify the dry source before vendors open the night loading bays.

entries.title: Irrigation vault stuck blade
entries.stakes: Irrigation Control Vault's isolator stalls under condensed glasshouse water. Protect the sprinkler control loop while freeing and reseating the contact blade.

entries.title: Pollen forecast clean reference
entries.stakes: Humidity makes Pollen Forecast Studio sensors report power that is not stable enough for the weather transmitter. Compare dry reference and misted readings.

entries.title: Gardeners academy records feed
entries.stakes: Archive trays in Gardeners Academy are endangered by condensed water dripping onto the teaching feeder. Isolate archive power before warming the cabinet contacts.

entries.title: Glass pavilion opening cutoff
entries.stakes: The Glass Pavilion Shelter must open before the greenhouse night temperature drops, but its entrance relay shorts whenever condensation reaches the frame.

entries.source_title: Pithead Feeder Cabin: Limited cable reel
entries.title: Pithead short cable reel
entries.stakes: A coal-water leak cuts the Pithead Feeder Cabin return. Allocate the only dry cable reel around the wet mine mouth without bonding it to the contaminated floor.

entries.source_title: Ore Conveyor Crossing: Staged pump sequence
entries.title: Ore crossing staged extraction
entries.stakes: Coal-water seepage floods the Ore Conveyor Crossing sump. Prime the relief pump before releasing the heavy conveyor because the main motor shares its breaker.

entries.title: Mine rescue earth isolation
entries.stakes: Coal-contaminated groundwater has formed an intermittent earth path into Mine Rescue Station's treatment room. Verify isolation without dropping its respirator supply.

entries.title: Old canteen alarm continuity
entries.stakes: The Old Canteen Bazaar's mine-warning beacon glows but its cable return lies under coal-water seepage. Rebuild the warning loop without reconnecting wet market sockets.

entries.title: Blackwater pump budget choice
entries.stakes: The Blackwater Lift Pump must divide scarce mine reserve power between rising seepage and shaft ventilation. Confirm essential drainage before higher-load extraction begins.

entries.source_title: Deep Shaft Signal Hub: False fuse alarm
entries.title: Deep shaft false fuse alert
entries.stakes: A coal-water sensor makes Deep Shaft Signal Hub report a blown fuse while the actual mine alarm rail is intact. Separate sensor errors from a real protective trip.

entries.title: Surface school drainage lock
entries.stakes: The Surface Safety Training floor lies above a coal-seepage conduit. Drain and prove the isolation gallery before restoring high-voltage rescue simulators.

entries.title: Muster yard reset discipline
entries.stakes: The Emergency Muster Yard's latched reserve panel cannot be reopened until coal-water leakage is isolated. Restore evacuation lights without rearming the mine hoist.

entries.title: Reservoir gallery dry splice
entries.stakes: Spillway rain has soaked a broken cable in the Reservoir Control Gallery. Dry the splice chamber before reconnecting the dam monitor and inlet warning lights.

entries.source_title: Crescent Spillway Walk: Controlled load shed
entries.title: Spillway walkway load shed
entries.stakes: The Crescent Spillway Walk shares a congested feeder with relief pumps during an inlet overflow. Shed decorative lighting without blacking out the safety barriers.

entries.title: Dam clinic generator allocation
entries.stakes: The Dam Operations Clinic must keep flood-response medical kits refrigerated during a storm-powered generator transfer. Reserve oxygen before enabling administrative outlets.

entries.title: Waterside shop pressure fault
entries.stakes: Rainwater behind the reservoir supply shop is causing an intermittent pressure trip in its service pumps. Identify the blocked sensor before reopening the storeroom.

entries.title: Emergency bypass pump priorities
entries.stakes: With reservoir levels rising, emergency pumps must start in a safe order rather than drawing capacity away from the dam gate controls. Set inlet relief first.

entries.title: Hydrology conflicting river levels
entries.stakes: Two flood sensors at Hydrology Telemetry Cabin disagree after spillway rain. Compare independent levels before the public warning system is certified safe.

entries.title: Water college access safeguard
entries.stakes: Overflow water has entered the Water Engineering College training-panel walkway. Lock the live inlet switch before apprentices can use the drainage simulation.

entries.title: Highbank pavilion breaker cooling
entries.stakes: The Highbank Relief Pavilion's breaker overheats while an overflow siren shares its branch. Cool the thermal link without silencing the warning network.

entries.title: Wrenwood crest restart route
entries.stakes: Tree roots have intruded into the Wrenwood Crest Board cable pit and now prevent the old bus from restarting. Isolate crushed runs before bringing houses back.

entries.source_title: Pine Tram Landing: Network loop hunt
entries.title: Pine landing circulating current
entries.stakes: A tram loop at Pine Tram Landing returns through a root-cracked earth cable. Break the feedback without dropping the grade-crossing warning lamps.

entries.source_title: Hillcrest Health Studio: Brief service window
entries.title: Hillcrest clinic service slot
entries.stakes: Root intrusions interrupt the Hillcrest Health Studio supply at predictable intervals. Use the short healthy period to shift refrigeration to a dry backup.

entries.title: Fir Row refrigerated produce
entries.stakes: Fir Row Grocer's cold produce is warming because roots squeezed the feeder sheath. Verify the intact bypass before removing the damaged refrigerator cable.

entries.source_title: Hollow Brook Pump Hut: Isolated bypass
entries.title: Hollow Brook isolated route
entries.stakes: Roots inside Hollow Brook Pump Hut's conduit create a return path around the safety switch. Separate that path before transferring potable water pumps.

entries.title: Canopy relay sag correction
entries.stakes: Tree roots are forcing Canopy Relay Treehouse's ground reference below safe voltage. Compare two antenna levels before trimming the repeater supply.

entries.source_title: Ranger Learning House: Limited cable reel
entries.title: Ranger school remaining reel
entries.stakes: Ranger Learning House has one short cable reel for its storm classroom. Measure the root-free route and keep the live forest-warning circuit separate.

entries.source_title: Woodland Commons Hall: Staged pump sequence
entries.title: Woodland hall staged relief
entries.stakes: Root intrusion has slowed Woodland Commons Hall's drain pump while rain reaches the entrance. Prime the reserve sump before bringing heaters onto the shared circuit.
